title: An amber note names both tiers when the new customer's tier differs
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on Default for work orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open work order 1's three-dot menu.
  3. Click Change Customer.
  4. Pick customer B.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu lists Change Customer, Split Work Order and Back to Work Orders.

Step 3:

  • The Change Customer dialog opens.

Step 4:

  • An amber note reads "This work order keeps Default pricing." then tier A's name "applies to new work orders, or split this one to use it."
  • The note is amber, not red.
  • Update Customer is on.
